animation:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE animation source atlas for EXP-LORE, with EXACTLY FOUR equal square cells arranged in a seamless 2-by-2 grid, reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. No labels, dividers, borders, gutters, numbers, text, background or checkerboard: transparent canvas only. Ideally 2048x2048 total, 1024x1024 per cell.
The attached glass sword is the EDIT TARGET and absolute design/style reference. In EVERY cell reproduce the EXACT SAME sword, same proportions, same fixed position WITHIN the cell and same scale and orientation: brown leather handle and brass round pommel lower LEFT, pale aqua glass tip upper RIGHT, dark steel straight crossguard with brass trim. Keep the handle, pommel and guard PIXEL-IDENTICAL and unmoving across all frames. Upper-left light and fine deliberate pixel-art style exactly as reference. No rotation, zoom, perspective changes or camera movement. Leave 9% clear margins inside EACH cell. Do not let any object cross its cell.
Animation is ONLY progressing cracks inside the glass blade, with no flying fragments:
Cell 1 / top-left: original intact glass blade, no cracks.
Cell 2 / top-right: same sword, ONE thin clear dark fracture across upper-middle blade.
Cell 3 / bottom-left: same sword with the main fracture branching into two additional clear fractures.
Cell 4 / bottom-right: same sword with several deep dark branching cracks and ONE tiny edge chip; blade is still full-length and attached to hilt.
The final frame must read clearly as a cracked glass sword, not a different weapon. Preserve the outer silhouette, blade tip position, hand anchor and every hilt detail. No glow, sparks, smoke, hands or loose shards. This atlas will be cropped into four frames and exported to a 256x64 strip, so exact registration matters more than embellishment.

Change ONLY the top of the hat: it must have a SOLID CLOSED FLAT DARK-CHOCOLATE TOP, an elliptical horizontal fabric disk, NOT an open hollow mouth, cup, bucket or pot. Keep the white icing-like trim along the outer upper rim and the two attached orange accents. Preserve the exact lower hat shape, brown crown, burgundy ribbon, buckle, brim, placement, light direction, fine pixel grain and dark contour. The top plane must unmistakably be a closed hat surface with a restrained upper-left highlight and no interior cavity. Transparent background, no other changes, no text or ground shadow.
